definitions.explanation: Loss or harm caused by a disaster, crime, accident, or other harmful event.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}による{被害|ひがい}が{大|おお}きかった。
examples.english: The damage from the typhoon was severe.

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}{者|しゃ}の{支援|しえん}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Support for the victims is needed.

notes:
{被害|ひがい} refers to damage or harm received, often from disasters, crimes, or accidents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {被害|ひがい}を{受|う}ける (to suffer damage)
- {被害|ひがい}が{出|で}る (damage occurs)
- 〜による{被害|ひがい} (damage caused by ~)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {被害|ひがい}{者|しゃ} (victim)
- {被害|ひがい}{届|とどけ} (damage report to police)
- {被害|ひがい}{額|がく} (amount of damage)
- {被害|ひがい}{状況|じょうきょう} (damage situation)

TYPES OF DAMAGE:
- {地震|じしん}の{被害|ひがい} (earthquake damage)
- {詐欺|さぎ}の{被害|ひがい} (fraud damage)
- {人的|じんてき}{被害|ひがい} (casualties, human losses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {損害|そんがい}: damage, loss (financial/legal focus)
- {害|がい}: harm, damage (more general)
